ca.title: Aave App Launches on TRON, Bringing USDT Deposits to Mobile Users on Android and iOS
ca.description: Geneva, Switzerland – TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), today announced that the Aave App, a high-yield savings mobile app developed and managed by Aave Labs, will add support for USDT (TRC-20) deposits on the TRON network as it expands to Android following its initial launch on iOS. The launch combines Android’s global reach with TRON’s leading role in the stablecoin ecosystem, expanding mobile access to onchain savings opportunities that are not accessible on traditional savings apps. With support for USDT on TRON, eligible users in supported jurisdictions can now deposit USDT on TRON and start earning yield on their savings. Android’s extensive global footprint offers a significant distribution opportunity for digital asset applications, particularly in markets where stablecoins are used for payments, remittances, and savings. TRON provides an established infrastructure for this opportunity, with more than $94 billion in circulating USDT, the largest circulating supply of Tether’s dollar-pegged stablecoin among blockchain networks. TRON also supports a broad range of stablecoin use cases, including payments, cross-border transfers, and digital asset transactions. Aave is building the World’s Savings App, a simple, globally accessible tool designed to help people grow and manage their savings, with a delightful design experience on the surface and powerful onchain finance infrastructure working under the hood. Users of the app can earn yield on their savings, enjoy flexible access to their funds, and benefit from the Balance Protection program. They can also deposit and withdraw via stablecoins or banks in eligible countries and project their potential savings growth over the years with a future simulator. Following its availability on iOS, the Android launch expands the app’s mobile reach, while TRON support connects users to one of the largest USDT ecosystems in onchain finance. “Aave Labs has a proven track record of building leading DeFi products, and the Aave App brings that expertise to everyday users,” said Justin Sun, Founder of TRON. “With TRON support on Android and iOS, more people can use the USDT they already hold on TRON to access simple, accessible onchain savings with the Aave App.” “Millions of people in emerging economies already rely on stablecoins on TRON to save and send money,” said Stani Kulechov, Founder and CEO of Aave Labs. “The Aave App lets them earn on those dollars.” By enabling USDT deposits through the Aave App on Android, the integration connects TRON’s established stablecoin ecosystem with a consumer-focused mobile application. The launch reflects the continued convergence of mobile applications and blockchain infrastructure, as consumer-focused products work to make digital assets and decentralized financial services more accessible worldwide. About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps. Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of November 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 414 million in total user accounts, more than 16 billion in total transactions, and over $24 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.” TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum About Aave Labs Aave Labs is a core contributor in the Aave network and builds products that make saving, lending and borrowing simple and accessible worldwide. Aave is the world’s largest onchain lending network, with more than $30 billion in net deposits. Users, fintechs and financial institutions use it to earn interest on stablecoins and other assets and to borrow against them, 24/7, with every transaction visible onchain. The network is governed by the Aave DAO, where AAVE holders vote on changes to the network and its treasury. Aave Labs’ products include Aave App, a savings app for everyone; Aave Pro, for advanced lending and borrowing; Aave Kit, which lets fintechs and businesses offer savings and loans to their users; and Aave Horizon, an institutional platform for borrowing stablecoins against tokenized real-world assets. For more information, visit aave.com.

La actualización, que hasta principios de mes solo existía en el programa beta, llega a cinco series de reloj a la vez y arregla un fallo que llevaba semanas afectando a algunos dispositivos. El despliegue va por fases y dentro de poco llegará a tu reloj. Cada actualización de Garmin llega por oleadas. No hay un botón que la active para todos a la vez, sino un porcentaje que va subiendo de forma progresiva para evitar que los servidores se sobrecarguen. Ese sistema sirve precisamente para frenar cualquier fallo antes de que llegue a millones de muñecas, y también explica por qué dos personas con el mismo reloj ven versiones distintas en el mismo momento del día. Durante las últimas horas, Garmin ha liberado la versión 29.52 para todos sus usuarios, que mejora el rendimiento y las funciones de muchos de sus relojes. Te contamos todos los detalles a continuación. Qué cambia con la versión 29.52 El fallo que más ha dado que hablar está en el Forerunner 965. Con la pantalla siempre encendida activada, el menú de ahorro de batería mostraba una estimación de autonomía que no cuadraba con el consumo real del reloj. El equipo gastaba lo mismo que antes, pero la cifra no tenía nada que ver con lo que luego aguantaba, y el usuario se quedaba sin saber cuánto le quedaba de verdad. La nueva versión vuelve a calcularla como es debido, por lo que la estimación vuelve a ser real. El segundo cambio afecta a la experiencia de usuario. Garmin dice que mejora el rendimiento de las vistas rápidas de widgets, esas pantallas que se abren al deslizar desde la esfera, y en la práctica se traduce en una experiencia mucho más fluida, sin ralentizaciones en el menú. La ficha que describe los cambios se queda ahí, con un tercer punto genérico de correcciones que afecta a los errores menores que se han detectado, pero que no detalla más. Qué modelos son compatibles Para comprobar si el reloj ya tiene la actualización pendiente, hay que entrar en el menú principal, bajar a Sistema, abrir Actualización de software y pulsar Buscar actualizaciones. La ruta es la misma en los cinco modelos compatibles, aunque el menú cambie de nombre según el dispositivo en cuestión y el software que tiene instalado.

sg.title: Aave App Launches on TRON, Bringing USDT Deposits to Mobile Users on Android and iOS
sg.description: Geneva, Switzerland – TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), today announced that the Aave App, a high-yield savings mobile app developed and managed by Aave Labs, will add support for USDT (TRC-20) deposits on the TRON network as it expands to Android following its initial launch on iOS. The launch combines Android’s global reach with TRON’s leading role in the stablecoin ecosystem, expanding mobile access to onchain savings opportunities that are not accessible on traditional savings apps. With support for USDT on TRON, eligible users in supported jurisdictions can now deposit USDT on TRON and start earning yield on their savings. Android’s extensive global footprint offers a significant distribution opportunity for digital asset applications, particularly in markets where stablecoins are used for payments, remittances, and savings. TRON provides an established infrastructure for this opportunity, with more than $94 billion in circulating USDT, the largest circulating supply of Tether’s dollar-pegged stablecoin among blockchain networks. TRON also supports a broad range of stablecoin use cases, including payments, cross-border transfers, and digital asset transactions. Aave is building the World’s Savings App, a simple, globally accessible tool designed to help people grow and manage their savings, with a delightful design experience on the surface and powerful onchain finance infrastructure working under the hood. Users of the app can earn yield on their savings, enjoy flexible access to their funds, and benefit from the Balance Protection program. They can also deposit and withdraw via stablecoins or banks in eligible countries and project their potential savings growth over the years with a future simulator. Following its availability on iOS, the Android launch expands the app’s mobile reach, while TRON support connects users to one of the largest USDT ecosystems in onchain finance. “Aave Labs has a proven track record of building leading DeFi products, and the Aave App brings that expertise to everyday users,” said Justin Sun, Founder of TRON. “With TRON support on Android and iOS, more people can use the USDT they already hold on TRON to access simple, accessible onchain savings with the Aave App.” “Millions of people in emerging economies already rely on stablecoins on TRON to save and send money,” said Stani Kulechov, Founder and CEO of Aave Labs. “The Aave App lets them earn on those dollars.” By enabling USDT deposits through the Aave App on Android, the integration connects TRON’s established stablecoin ecosystem with a consumer-focused mobile application. The launch reflects the continued convergence of mobile applications and blockchain infrastructure, as consumer-focused products work to make digital assets and decentralized financial services more accessible worldwide. About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps. Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of November 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 414 million in total user accounts, more than 16 billion in total transactions, and over $24 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.” TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum About Aave Labs Aave Labs is a core contributor in the Aave network and builds products that make saving, lending and borrowing simple and accessible worldwide. Aave is the world’s largest onchain lending network, with more than $30 billion in net deposits. Users, fintechs and financial institutions use it to earn interest on stablecoins and other assets and to borrow against them, 24/7, with every transaction visible onchain. The network is governed by the Aave DAO, where AAVE holders vote on changes to the network and its treasury. Aave Labs’ products include Aave App, a savings app for everyone; Aave Pro, for advanced lending and borrowing; Aave Kit, which lets fintechs and businesses offer savings and loans to their users; and Aave Horizon, an institutional platform for borrowing stablecoins against tokenized real-world assets. ph.title: 18 Years of TechPinas: From The Golden Age of Blogging to The Dawn of AI Era, Our Story Continues
ph.description: Celebrating 18 years of TechPinas, from the golden age of blogging in 2008 to the dawn of the AI-driven world in 2026, with gratitude, purpose, and a continuing commitment to Filipino communities. Technology continues to evolve, making work easier and life more enjoyable, but the human heart, creativity, and purpose behind every story remain. Embracing the possibilities of AI while staying present, inspired, and firmly in control of the journey ahead. Eighteen years. Thousands of stories. Countless friendships, opportunities, challenges, and blessings. What started in 2008 as a humble technology blog has grown into something that continues to be a deeply meaningful and fulfilling part of my life. Today, as TechPinas celebrates its 18th anniversary, my heart is filled with gratitude. Looking back at everything that has happened since those early days of blogging, I can only say that the journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. Technology has changed tremendously over the past 18 years. The way we communicate, work, learn, create, and connect has evolved beyond what many of us could have imagined in 2008. Through all these changes, TechPinas has remained committed to one mission: Sharing Specs and Beyond to Help Build a Tech-Informed, Tech-Empowered Nation. As we enter an exciting new chapter shaped by artificial intelligence, that mission feels more relevant than ever. TechPinas remains committed to its augmented vision of also Bringing Technology Closer To The Hearts, Minds, and Hands of Filipino Communities Worldwide. First and Foremost, Thank You, Lord! First and foremost, above everything else, I give thanks and glory to the Lord for the gift of these 18 years. I know that none of this would have been possible without His grace, guidance, protection, and countless blessings. There have been wonderful seasons filled with exciting opportunities and unforgettable experiences. There have also been difficult moments when the future seemed uncertain and I had to find the strength to keep going. Through it all, the Lord has been faithful. Maraming salamat po, Panginoon! I am grateful for the doors He has opened, the people He has brought into my life, and the opportunities He continues to provide for me to learn, grow, and serve others through my work. As TechPinas turns 18, my prayer is that I may continue to use this platform responsibly, with humility, integrity, compassion, and a genuine desire to make a positive difference. To God be all the glory! To My Family, My Greatest Blessing and Source of Strength To my family, thank you for your unconditional love, understanding, encouragement, and support throughout this journey. Building and maintaining an independent digital publication for 18 years has required a great deal of time, patience, sacrifice, and perseverance. There have been long days, late nights, busy schedules, and moments when work demanded more of my attention than I would have liked. Through all these years, my family has remained an important source of strength and inspiration. My mom Alita Macanas, my dad Engineer Mario Macanas, my younger brother Val Marvin and his partner Camille, and my little nephews, Jalenn Cam and Hezekiah Mikael. No professional achievement, recognition, or milestone could ever replace the love and support of the people who matter most in my life. I am deeply grateful to have them beside me as I continue this journey. From the Golden Age of Blogging to a New Digital World When I launched TechPinas in 2008, blogging was enjoying a remarkable period of growth. Independent websites gave ordinary people the opportunity to share their knowledge, experiences, and perspectives with audiences around the world. It was an exciting time to be a technology enthusiast. Feature phones were still widely used, laptops and netbooks were popular, and smartphones were only beginning to reveal their potential. Over the years, we witnessed the rise of Android, the rapid evolution of mobile photography, the expansion of broadband and 4G LTE, the arrival of 5G, and the emergence of devices and services that transformed everyday life. Alongside these developments came enormous changes in digital publishing. Social media reshaped how people discovered information. Video platforms introduced new forms of storytelling. Content creators became important voices in technology marketing and consumer education. More recently, artificial intelligence has begun transforming how information is produced, distributed, and consumed. Not every transition has been easy. Like many independent publishers, I have had to continuously learn, adjust, experiment, and reinvent the way I work. But one thing has remained constant: My love for technology and my desire to share useful information with fellow Filipinos. For me, TechPinas has never been just about specifications, product launches, or the latest gadgets. It has always been about helping people understand technology and appreciate how innovation can make their lives better. To Our Brand Partners and Industry Friends, Thank You for Your Trust One of the greatest blessings of running TechPinas for 18 years has been the opportunity to work with remarkable people and organizations across the technology industry. To the brands, marketing teams, public relations professionals, communications agencies, and industry partners who have trusted TechPinas through the years, thank you from the bottom of my heart. I deeply appreciate the opportunities you have given me to experience new technologies, share meaningful stories, attend important events, and introduce innovative products and services to Filipino consumers. Behind every successful product launch and marketing campaign are hardworking people who dedicate their time, creativity, expertise, and resources to bringing their ideas to life. Having witnessed this dedication firsthand, I have developed tremendous respect for the professionals who help move our industry forward. I am especially grateful to the companies and individuals who continue to believe in the value of TechPinas, even as the digital media landscape becomes increasingly competitive and complex. Your trust means so much to me. I hope that the relationships we have built over the years will continue to grow through mutual respect, professionalism, shared opportunities, and a common desire to bring meaningful innovations closer to Filipinos. To Our Readers, Subscribers, Viewers, and Supporters, This Milestone Belongs to You Of course, TechPinas would not have reached its 18th year without the people who continue to read, watch, share, and support our content. Whether you have been following TechPinas since its earliest blogging days or discovered our content only recently, please know that I sincerely appreciate you. Thank you for reading our articles, watching our videos, subscribing to our channels, following our social media pages, sharing our posts, and taking the time to engage with the stories we publish. Every visit, comment, message, recommendation, and word of encouragement has contributed to this journey. Some of you have been around long enough to remember the earliest smartphones and gadgets we featured. Others belong to a new generation discovering technology through social media, short-form videos, and AI-powered platforms. Regardless of when you became part of the TechPinas community, I am grateful that you are here. Your continued support reminds me that the true value of content creation is not measured solely by pageviews, follower counts, or viral moments. It is also reflected in the trust we build, the knowledge we share, and the positive impact our work can have on others. Thank you for allowing TechPinas to be part of your technology journey. 2026: Helping Herald the Age of Artificial Intelligence This year has been particularly meaningful because we are witnessing what could become one of the most transformative periods in the history of modern technology. Artificial intelligence is no longer merely a futuristic concept. It is becoming an increasingly important part of education, business, communication, creativity, cybersecurity, and everyday productivity. One of the highlights of my year was participating in the VST ECS CXO Tech Summit 2026, held at Shangri-La Boracay from October 20 to 23, under the theme Rethinking IT: Powering the AI-Driven Enterprise. The gathering brought together technology leaders, industry experts, and representatives from different sectors to explore how organizations can prepare for a future increasingly shaped by AI. What made the experience especially meaningful for me was the opportunity to help bring attention to the role of educational institutions in preparing the next generation of Filipinos for an AI-driven world. During the media briefing, I raised a question about the growing participation of schools and universities in the summit, including Ateneo de Manila University, Miriam College, and National University. I wanted to learn how technology companies were helping educators and students develop AI-related skills while promoting responsible and safe use of these powerful tools. The responses highlighted important initiatives involving teacher training, cybersecurity education, industry-academe collaboration, and access to emerging technologies. For me, these conversations reinforced a belief that has guided TechPinas for many years: Technology becomes truly meaningful when its benefits reach more people. AI should not be something that only large corporations, highly trained professionals, or privileged communities can understand and use. Its benefits should also become accessible to students, teachers, small business owners, independent creators, and everyday Filipinos who want to improve their lives. Through our coverage of developments in AI, digital connectivity, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies, I hope TechPinas can continue contributing to these important conversations. The Age of AI presents extraordinary possibilities, but it also comes with responsibilities. We need to encourage innovation while promoting digital literacy, critical thinking, online safety, and the ethical use of technology. As a technology publisher, I consider it a privilege to help communicate these ideas to a wider Filipino audience. A New Chapter for Independent Content Creation Turning 18 also gives me an opportunity to reflect on what TechPinas can become in the years ahead. I believe independent content creators and publishers still have an important role to play, even in a world where information is available almost instantly and AI can generate content in seconds. Technology can help us work faster and reach more people, but human experiences, authentic relationships, personal perspectives, and genuine concern for our communities remain incredibly valuable. For TechPinas, the next chapter is about embracing the opportunities of the Independent Content Producer Era while staying true to the values that have sustained this platform since 2008. That means continuing to create informative articles, useful videos, practical product features, and meaningful stories that help Filipinos make better decisions about technology. It also means remaining open to new formats, platforms, collaborations, and ways of serving our audience. I do not know exactly what the next 18 years will bring. If the past two decades have taught me anything, it is that technology will continue to surprise us and that adaptability will always be essential. But whatever changes come, I hope TechPinas will continue to be a platform that informs, inspires, empowers, and brings people together. Eighteen Years Later, The Mission Continues As I look back on this journey, I realize that the greatest rewards have not necessarily been the gadgets I've reviewed, the events I've attended, or the milestones I've achieved. They have been the people I've met, the friendships I've formed, the lessons I've learned, and the opportunities I've been given to serve others through something I genuinely love doing. To the Lord, my family, our brand partners, industry friends, fellow content creators, readers, subscribers, viewers, and everyone who has supported TechPinas in ways both big and small, thank you, thank you, thank you! Thank you for being part of these 18 wonderful years. Thank you for believing in this journey and for giving me reasons to keep learning, growing, and moving forward. My hope is that TechPinas will continue to deserve your trust by creating content that is useful, accessible, responsible, and grounded in a sincere desire to help others. As we move further into the Age of Artificial Intelligence, may we never lose sight of the people whom technology is meant to serve. Here's to more meaningful stories, stronger friendships, exciting innovations, and opportunities to make a positive difference. Happy 18th Anniversary, TechPinas! From the golden age of blogging to the AI era, our story continues. With a grateful heart, Mark of TechPinas Founder and Editor-in-Chief Our Vision and Mission: The Heart of TechPinas As we celebrate 18 years of sharing technology stories, we also reaffirm the purpose that has guided TechPinas since its beginning and the expanded vision that will inspire our journey in the years ahead. Our Mission Sharing Specs and Beyond to Help Build a Tech-Informed, Tech-Empowered Nation. To inform and empower Filipinos about technology wherever they are. Through accessible information, practical insights, and meaningful content, we aim to help individuals and communities better understand technology and use it to improve their lives. Our Expanded Vision Bringing Technology Closer To The Hearts, Minds, and Hands of Filipino Communities Worldwide. We envision a future where technology is not merely something Filipinos read about or admire from afar, but something they can understand, appreciate, access, and confidently use to create opportunities for themselves, their families, and their communities. As TechPinas embraces its Independent Content Producer Era and dives into the AI Era, we remain committed to making technology more relatable, inclusive, and empowering through stories that connect innovation with real human experiences, beyond Artificial Intelligence. From the Philippines to Filipino communities around the world, we hope to continue serving as a bridge between technological progress and the people whose lives it can transform. 18 years of passion, gratitude, service, and Pinoy Pride -- and by God's grace, many more years of meaningful storytelling ahead. ph.title: Proud Ilonggo moment: Army general hailed for escorting Trump
ph.description: ILOILO CITY—While there were protests all over the country against Donald Trump's visit, Iloilo hailed one of its own for getting the job done as the military escort during the Nov. 17 arrival honors for the United States (US) president. Ilonggo netizens proundly pointed out that Brigadier General Von Albert Sumergido was a native of Santa Barbara town in Iloilo province. The video of Sumergido—walking alongside Trump with Air Force One in the background at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA)—was seen by millions across the globe in live broadcasts and various photographs published by the media. But more noteworthy than Sumergido's 15 minutes of fame with Trump is his being a career soldier and the current commander of the Philippine Army’s 1st Brigade Combat Team (1BCT). Sumergido is one of the pioneer officers of 1BCT, dating back to the unit's activation in 2018. In 2020, Sumergido took over as the chief of the Office of the Secretary Army General Staff (OSAGS). He had also served in other various positions in the Armor Division, 2nd Infantry Division, Training and Doctrine Command, Presidential Security Group (PSG), and Office of the Assistant Chief of Staff for Plans, Philippine Army (OG5, PA). Sumergido graduated from the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) in 1995. He was raised in Iloilo and graduated from the University of the Philippines High School Iloilo (UPHSI) in 1989.

ph.title: Local equities extend modest gains amid ASEAN optimism, inflation drag
ph.description: Local equities market extended gains for a second straight session, though the benchmark index managed to recover barely a quarter of Monday’s steep selloff as optimism from the regional leaders’ summit collided with domestic stagflation worries. The Philippine Stock Exchange index (PSEi) rose 10.96 points, or 0.2 percent, to close at 5,511.84 on Wednesday, Nov. 18, building on Tuesday’s 19-point advance. Even after back-to-back increases, the combined 29.96-point rebound accounts for just 26.8 percent of Monday’s 111.61-point drop. Rizal Commercial Banking Corp. (RCBC) chief economist Michael Ricafort linked recent gains to the Philippines’ hosting of the recently concluded Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit, pointing to potential benefits for spending, tourism and investment. He described lower global oil prices as the main support for stocks, saying the decline could ease inflation pressures and help keep the peso steady. “However, the lack of fresh catalysts and lingering stagflation concerns continued to weigh on investor sentiment, limiting buying interest and keeping the market's recovery modest,” Regina Capital Development Corp. (RCDC) managing director Luis Limlingan said. Ricafort also attributed the limited recovery partly to tensions between the United States (US) and Iran. ph.title: DepEd develops 15-minute screening tool to detect learning, speech problems among pupils
ph.description: The Department of Education (DepEd) has developed a new screening tool that allows teachers to check in about 15 minutes if a Grade 2 pupil may have learning or speech difficulties, a process that previously took up to two hours. Called Project SABAY (Screening using AI-Based Assistance for Young Children), the tool is designed to help teachers identify children who may need further assessment and assistance from specialists at an earlier stage. Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a press statement that the tool offers a faster way to check for possible learning and communication difficulties compared to traditional methods such as the Multi-Factored Assessment Tool (MFAT). “Technology must work for our most vulnerable learners and the teachers who guide them,” Angara said. He said Project SABAY would help teachers spot difficulties earlier while making the assessment process easier for both teachers and young learners. “By providing them with transparent, data-driven tools that show step-by-step results, we are giving our teachers the confidence and clarity they need to partner effectively with parents and secure early interventions,” he said. Developed by the DepEd Bureau of Learning Delivery–Student Inclusion Division and the Education Center for AI Research, the tool uses a teacher-assisted application that presents screening activities in the form of interactive stories and games. The activities include naming pictures, writing down words, spelling unfamiliar or made-up words, and speaking freely. Maelou Jean Salve, a Master Teacher II at Lawaan III Elementary School in Talisay City, Cebu, said the tool makes the screening process easier for teachers. “Napapadali po nito ang trabaho ng isang teacher (This makes a teacher's work easier),” Salve said. She said traditional assessments such as the Early Childhood Care and Development (ECCD) Checklist and MFAT require teachers to prepare materials before they can conduct the screening. “As a teacher, when it comes to administering the ECCD Checklist and MFAT, it is time consuming because we still need to prepare materials. But with Project SABAY, the assessment tool is already given and prepared. It saves a lot of time and effort,” she said. DepEd said the tool also provides teachers with a breakdown of the results, making it easier for them to explain their findings to parents and discuss what kind of help their children may need. The screening tool is expected to help address delays in getting children assessed by developmental specialists, as a shortage of these professionals has resulted in waiting periods of up to a year or longer. Early identification can help parents and teachers seek professional assessment and appropriate support sooner. After its initial testing in the National Capital Region, DepEd has expanded data gathering to the Visayas and Mindanao, with more areas in Luzon expected to take part. The expanded testing will help determine how well the tool works among children from different cultural and language backgrounds before its nationwide implementation.

bd.description: Proposing reciprocating and screw compressors and air dryers; targeting December launch of website and promotional video SEOUL, South Korea, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hanmi Compressor, a Daegu-based industrial air compressor specialist, is preparing to enter Southeast Asia with Vietnam as its first target market. The company announced that it will produce a website and promotional video to introduce its products and installation and maintenance services to overseas buyers. Hanmi Compressor Hanmi Compressor plans to first identify local manufacturers and industrial machinery distributors in Vietnam. With manufacturers, it will assess demand for the compressed air needed by their production facilities; with distributors, it will look at which products they can handle and what local technical support conditions are available. Drawing on its experience in Korea supplying, installing, and maintaining equipment together, the company is considering a business approach in Vietnam that links equipment selection with after-sales service. The flagship products it will propose locally are reciprocating compressors, screw compressors, and air dryers. Reciprocating compressors address demand from a variety of industrial sites, including small workshops, while screw compressors will be introduced to manufacturing plants that use compressed air continuously. The company will also propose air dryers, which remove moisture contained in compressed air, along with related equipment. The specific product configuration will be determined based on the results of local research, since equipment scale, air consumption, and operating conditions differ even among manufacturers in the same industry. Hanmi Compressor intends to select the product lineup best suited for supply by considering not only the required air volume and operating conditions but also local conditions for inspecting equipment and replacing parts. The website and corporate promotional video are targeted for production in December 2026. The website will contain a company introduction, major products, and information on installation and maintenance services, and will be used to receive overseas inquiries. The company is also considering English content and ways to support Vietnamese. The promotional video will feature the company's history, which began in 1984 in Daegu's Bukseong-ro, as well as its in-house maintenance facility and key installation and maintenance capabilities. The specific release date will be determined depending on production progress. The business is currently at the preparation stage for identifying buyers. After setting up promotional materials and an inquiry channel, the company plans to pursue export consultations with Vietnamese manufacturers and industrial machinery distributors. It has not yet announced any specific buyer consultation results or export contracts. After identifying product demand and transaction terms in Vietnam, Hanmi Compressor plans to define distribution partnership approaches suited to the local market. Building on the market research and consultation experience gained in Vietnam, the company also intends to explore the possibility of expanding into other Southeast Asian countries.

pk.title: World: Community-led negotiations
pk.description: Please refer to the attached file. The Centre for Competence on Humanitarian Negotiation (CCHN) commissioned the Humanitarian Policy Group at ODI Global to conduct research on community-led negotiations, particularly the processes that community negotiators undertake to engage with authorities and armed actors for humanitarian access and protection. Specifically, the study seeks to answer the following research questions: What triggers the decision to engage in direct negotiations? How do community negotiators prepare for such engagements? What is the process taken in negotiations? What are their risk-mitigation strategies? What are the tactics and strategies used in the negotiation process? What factors influence the outcome of negotiations? What follow-up actions take place once an agreement is reached? What type of support do community negotiators most need? The findings presented in this report identified that community negotiation practices are often instinctual, unstructured, and rarely documented. Stemming from 13 countries across diverse contexts, the results strongly suggest that community negotiators prepare strategically for dialogue, similarly to what is set out in the Naivasha Grid. As noted, the greater the international support, the more aligned the community negotiations become with international humanitarian practices. However, the process varies according to the context and is generally more organic than international negotiation practices.

sa.description: قاد ولي العهد البريطاني الأمير ويليام عربة «توك توك» كهربائية، المعروفة في الهند باسم «الريكشا»، في شوارع مدينة مومباي، وإلى جانبه زوجته الأميرة كاثرين، في مشهد لافت تزامن مع إعلان الفائزين بجائزة «إيرثشوت» البيئية، وفقاً لصحيفة «ذا نيويورك تايمز».وشهدت الفعالية إعلان أسماء خمسة فائزين من بين 15 جهة وصلت إلى التصفيات النهائية، وحصل كل فائز على نحو 1.3 مليون دولار لدعم الحلول المبتكرة لمواجهة التحديات البيئية وتوسيع نطاق تطبيقها.وضمت قائمة الفائزين شركة «ماهيندرا لاست مايل موبيليتي» الهندية، المصنعة للعربة الكهربائية التي قادها الأمير ويليام، ومؤسسة «نيوي أوشن وايد ترست» في جزيرة نيوي بالمحيط الهادئ، تقديراً لابتكارها نموذجاً مستداماً لحماية البحار.كما شملت القائمة مجموعة «PFAS-Free France»، التي قادت حملة لحظر المواد الكيميائية الأبدية في فرنسا، وشركة «أورستد» الدنماركية العاملة في مجال طاقة الرياح البحرية، إلى جانب مملكة بوتان، تقديراً لجهودها في حماية البيئة والحفاظ على غطاء غابي يغطي نحو 70% من أراضيها.وأكد الأمير ويليام، خلال لقائه المتأهلين، أن الحلول البيئية موجودة بالفعل، مشيراً إلى أن مهمة الجائزة، التي أُطلقت قبل ست سنوات، تتمثل في اكتشاف أصحاب هذه المبادرات ودعمهم ومساعدتهم على توسيع نطاق تأثيرها.زيارة ملكية ورسائل بيئية من الهندوتكتسب الزيارة أهمية خاصة، باعتبارها أول رحلة خارجية مشتركة للأمير ويليام والأميرة كاثرين منذ خضوع الأخيرة للعلاج من السرطان عام 2024، كما تمثل دفعة إعلامية للجائزة في ظل أزمات وفضائح ملكية أثارت تساؤلات حول صورتها وداعميها.وجاء اختيار الهند، التي يبلغ عدد سكانها نحو 1.4 مليار نسمة، لتسليط الضوء على التحديات البيئية التي تواجهها، بين آثار التغير المناخي والجهود الرامية إلى الحد من التلوث.وسجلت مومباي، الثلاثاء، مستويات من الجسيمات الدقيقة تجاوزت بكثير الحدود الآمنة التي توصي بها منظمة الصحة العالمية، فيما تعاني العاصمة نيودلهي موجات متكررة من التلوث الحاد خلال فصل الشتاء.وفي ظل حساسية تناول ملف التلوث البيئي من جانب أحد أفراد العائلة الملكية البريطانية، مع تصاعد النزعة القومية في الهند، حرص مسؤولو القصر على تذكير الصحفيين بأن لندن عانت بدورها أزمات حادة في تلوث الهواء خلال خمسينيات القرن الماضي.«الريكشا» الكهربائية.. رهان على مستقبل النقلوقالت سومان ميشرا، المديرة التنفيذية لشركة «ماهيندرا لاست مايل موبيليتي»، إن الشركة باعت أكثر من 400 ألف مركبة كهربائية خلال أربع سنوات، ما أسهم في خفض انبعاثات ثاني أكسيد الكربون بنحو 180 ألف طن متري، مشيرة إلى أن الشركة تستهدف بيع مليون مركبة بحلول عام 2030.وأضافت أن العربة الكهربائية تستطيع قطع أكثر من 193 كيلومتراً بشحنة واحدة، بما يكفي لتغطية يوم عمل كامل.وأكدت أن التحدي الأساسي يتمثل في جعل التحول إلى المركبات الكهربائية خياراً منافساً اقتصادياً، وليس مجرد مسؤولية بيئية، وهو ما يتطلب توفير مساحات كافية للوقوف والشحن في المدن المزدحمة، إلى جانب تخفيف القيود التنظيمية.

sa.title: تحذير أمني عاجل لمستخدمي «Java».. ثغرات خطيرة تسمح باختراق الأنظمة والتحكم فيها عن بُعد
sa.description: دعت السلطات الأمريكية والكورية الجنوبية مستخدمي لغة البرمجة «جافا» (Java) إلى تثبيت التحديثات الأمنية بشكل عاجل، عقب اكتشاف ثغرات خطيرة قد تسمح للمهاجمين الإلكترونيين بتنفيذ تعليمات برمجية عن بُعد أو التسبب في تعطل الأنظمة المستهدفة، ما أثار مخاوف بشأن أمن البنية التحتية الرقمية للمؤسسات الحكومية والمالية والعسكرية.وفي مؤشر على خطورة الموقف، عقد المكتب الرئاسي في كوريا الجنوبية اجتماعًا طارئًا، مساء (الثلاثاء)، بمشاركة الجهات الحكومية المعنية، لمناقشة الإجراءات الوقائية اللازمة للتعامل مع الثغرات المكتشفة، وفقًا لما أوردته وكالة الأنباء الكورية الجنوبية «يونهاب».وتُعد لغة «جافا» من لغات البرمجة واسعة الانتشار، إذ تُستخدم في تشغيل وتطوير أنظمة معلومات حيوية لدى المؤسسات الحكومية والشركات والقطاع المصرفي، فضلًا عن بعض الأنظمة المستخدمة في المؤسسات العسكرية، كما تتوافر من خلال شركة «أوراكل» ومجموعات تطوير مفتوحة المصدر.تحذير أمريكي من ضرورة تثبيت التحديثات فورًامن جانبها، أصدرت وكالة الأمن السيبراني وأمن البنية التحتية الأمريكية تحذيرًا أمنيًا دعت فيه إلى معالجة الثغرات المكتشفة وتثبيت التصحيحات البرمجية دون تأخير، نظرًا للمخاطر التي قد تترتب على استغلالها.ولم تربط الوكالة الأمريكية هذه الثغرات بأي من الأعطال التقنية التي شهدتها الولايات المتحدة مؤخرًا، مؤكدة بذلك ضرورة التعامل مع المشكلة باعتبارها تهديدًا أمنيًا يستوجب إجراءات وقائية عاجلة.وفي السياق ذاته، أصدرت شركة «أوراكل» تحديثًا أمنيًا لمجموعة تطوير لغة Java (JDK)، يوم 17 نوفمبر، يتضمن إصلاحات للثغرات المكتشفة.كوريا الجنوبية الأكثر عرضة للمخاطر بسبب انتشار «جافا»وتبرز كوريا الجنوبية باعتبارها إحدى الدول الأكثر اعتمادًا على لغة Java، وهو ما يزيد من أهمية التحذيرات الأمنية الصادرة بشأنها، خاصة في ظل انتشار استخدامها داخل المؤسسات الحكومية والقطاع الخاص.وبحسب دراسة أجرتها شركة عالمية متخصصة في أدوات تطوير البرمجيات، بلغت حصة لغة Java نحو 53% من إجمالي استخدام لغات البرمجة في كوريا الجنوبية، مقارنة بمتوسط عالمي بلغ 30%.كما أظهرت دراسة حكومية صدرت العام الماضي أن نسبة استخدام Java في أنظمة المعلومات التابعة للقطاع العام الكوري وصلت إلى 72% من إجمالي استخدام لغات البرمجة، ما يعكس مدى اعتماد المؤسسات الحكومية عليها.وأشارت البيانات إلى أن الصين وألمانيا تأتيان أيضًا ضمن الدول التي تسجل معدلات مرتفعة في استخدام هذه اللغة.وفي هذا الإطار، دعت وزارة العلوم وتكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات الكورية الجنوبية، بالتعاون مع وكالة الإنترنت والأمن الكورية، الأربعاء، المؤسسات العامة والشركات الخاصة إلى تثبيت التحديثات الأمنية بصورة عاجلة، لتقليل احتمالات استغلال الثغرات واختراق أنظمتها.مخاوف متزايدة من الهجمات السيبرانية المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعيوتأتي هذه التطورات في وقت تتصاعد فيه المخاوف العالمية بشأن الأمن السيبراني، بالتزامن مع التسارع الكبير في تطوير تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي، وظهور حوادث مرتبطة بوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي المستقلين، إلى جانب تزايد الأعطال التقنية التي طالت خدمات رقمية ومؤسسات كبرى خلال الأيام الماضية.وتشير شركات متخصصة في الأمن السيبراني إلى رصد حالات يستخدم فيها قراصنة تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لتنفيذ أعداد كبيرة من محاولات الاختراق بصورة متزامنة، الأمر الذي يزيد من تعقيد مواجهة التهديدات الرقمية.وكانت مجموعة من المواقع الحكومية والتجارية حول العالم قد تعرضت الشهر الماضي للتوقف الاحترازي، عقب الكشف عن ثغرات أمنية خطيرة في لغة البرمجة «PHP»، المستخدمة في تشغيل أجزاء واسعة من الإنترنت، وهو ما أعقبه رصد ملايين محاولات الاختراق.كما شهد الأسبوع الماضي سلسلة من الاضطرابات التقنية، شملت تعطل عدد من خدمات شركة «مايكروسوفت»، بما فيها خدمات البريد الإلكتروني، إلى جانب توقف حركة الطيران في الولايات المتحدة لمدة 4 ساعات ونصف تقريبًا، ومشكلة برمجية لدى بنك «جيه بي مورجان تشيس» أثرت على بعض الخدمات المصرفية.ارتفاع الحوادث السيبرانية يثير قلق شركات التأمينوفي مؤشر إضافي على تصاعد المخاطر، أعلنت شركة التأمين «مارش» أن عملاءها أبلغوا عن 105 حوادث سيبرانية خلال النصف الثاني من أكتوبر، وهو ما يزيد على ضعف الحوادث المسجلة خلال النصف الثاني من مايو، والتي بلغت 48 حادثة.ورغم هذه المؤشرات، قللت إدارة الرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترمب من احتمالات وجود مشكلة أمنية شاملة تقف وراء الأعطال المتلاحقة.وقال وزير الخارجية الأمريكي ماركو روبيو، الذي يشغل أيضًا منصب مستشار الأمن القومي، إن تكرار هذه الحوادث أمر يثير القلق، لكنه شدد على أنها غير مرتبطة ببعضها البعض.وأضاف روبيو، خلال تصريحات أدلى بها للصحفيين في العاصمة الفلبينية مانيلا، على هامش اجتماعات رابطة دول جنوب شرق آسيا (آسيان): «نحن لسنا تحت هجوم ممنهج».اليابان تتحرك لمواجهة مخاطر الهجمات المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعيوفي سياق متصل، أعلنت اليابان في أواخر الشهر الماضي اعتزامها تشكيل فريق متخصص لمحاكاة الهجمات السيبرانية باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي، بهدف اكتشاف نقاط الضعف في الأنظمة التكنولوجية وتحديد الثغرات قبل أن يتمكن المهاجمون من استغلالها.وتعكس هذه التحركات تزايد الاهتمام الدولي بتعزيز أمن البنية التحتية الرقمية، في ظل اتساع الاعتماد على الأنظمة البرمجية في إدارة الخدمات الحكومية والمالية والعسكرية، وتصاعد التحديات المرتبطة بتطور أدوات الهجوم الإلكتروني.

tn.title: عملية سطو هادئة من الدولة الإجتماعية على أموال صندوق النهوض بالمسكن لفائدة الأجراء
tn.description: صندوق « فوبرولوس » وُلد لغاية واحدة في 3 أوت 1977، أُحدث صندوق النهوض بالمسكن لفائدة الأجراء بمقتضى القانون عدد 54. وكانت الغاية منه واضحة لا تحتمل التأويل: أن يمتلك الأجير محدود الدخل مسكنًا. ولتحقيقها، فُرض على كلّ مؤجّر أن يدفع 1% من كتلة الأجور. هذا المال مقتطع من الشغل، ومخصّص بالقانون للسكن، ولا شيء غير السكن. وقد موّل الصندوق منذ إحداثه أكثر من 65 ألف مسكن أزمة يعيشها الجميع إلا من يحكم تضاعفت كلفة السكن في تونس خلال خمس عشرة سنة. فبحسب الباعثين العقاريين، الشقة التي كانت تُباع بـ150 ألف دينار سنة 2010 لا يقلّ ثمنها اليوم عن 350 ألفًا. في L’article عملية سطو هادئة من الدولة الإجتماعية على أموال صندوق النهوض بالمسكن لفائدة الأجراء est apparu en premier sur Actualités Tunisie Focus.
